_comment: Elite CCRL Blitz anchor set (2615-3491) for rustfish at ~2650-2700+. Ratings from the CCRL Blitz complete list dated 2026-10-27 (+-13..18 each, single-CPU entries); the 3000-3210 anchors added on 2026-11-02 use the 2026-10-31 list and were built and UCI-smoke-tested locally (viridithas-4.0.0, black-marlin-4.0, stash-28/30/31). Same build kinds as scripts/anchors.json; all are HCE except reckless-0.3.0/0.4.0 (net embedded from data/weights.bin in-repo); no build-time net downloads. simbelmyne-1.7.0 pulls crates.io deps via its Cargo.lock (clap, rayon, ...); all others are dependency-free. Risks: stash v21.0/v25.0 build with -Werror (newer GCC warnings could break them; v19/v20.0.1 built fine); zahak 6.2 has no Book UCI option (book is off unless -book is passed). Excluded from the 3000+ additions: Smallbrain 4.0.0 (types.h uses uint8_t without <cstdint>, fails on GCC 13) and Princhess 0.17.0 (bindgen needs libclang, absent on the runners); Smallbrain 5.0.0 is 3221, outside the target band. Excluded: Blunder 7.x/8.x (RunCommLoop and UCILoop each wrap stdin in their own bufio.Reader, so piped smoke input after 'uci' is swallowed: the cause of the 6.1.0/7.4.0 'go depth 4' failures, and 8.5.5 has the same pattern); Zahak 7.1 (needs 'make netgen' to generate engine/nn.go); Velvet 2.0.0 (packed_simd_2, nightly only); Pedantic (C#). Select with: gh workflow run ccrl-ladder.yml -f anchors_file=scripts/anchors-elite.json black-marlin-4.0 removed 2026-11-06: it scored 15-20% against rustfish while 3150-3210 anchors scored ~50%, so its build is broken (likely missing its net) and it inflated fits by ~30 Elo. 3273-3491 anchors added 2026-11-06 from the 2026-10-31 list (single-CPU entries, +-8..15), built and smoke-tested only on CI: stash-33/35/37 (HCE), weiss-2.0 (HCE; WARN=-Wall drops its -Werror, which GCC on the runners trips in pyrrhic), reckless-0.6.0 (net in repo), koivisto-6.0 and reckless-0.7.0 (their nets live outside the repo: the workflow fetches them from a commit-pinned net_url and checks net_sha256 before building, so a missing or wrong net fails the build instead of silently playing weak, the black-marlin failure mode). Kind 'make' runs make -C <dir> <make_args> and copies <out>.
